meta.threshold_justification: Grain invariant: one fact row = one (day, municipality, victim cohort, mechanism). A duplicate would double-count victims and also violate the uq_fact_grano constraint in PostgreSQL.
Key readiness: a null foreign key cannot be loaded (NOT NULL FK) and would drop the row from every star join.

Referential readiness: an orphan key would make the FK constraint reject the whole load.

Derived-attribute rule: the R6 ratio and the R7 gap max(0, required - installed) are only defined for non-negative installed counts.

Structural ceiling: Colombia has roughly 1,100 municipalities plus 18 non-municipalized areas (DIVIPOLA) that by law have no comisaría and can never match (about 1.6%). Coverage below 98% means real municipalities stopped matching (key or API regression), which biases R6/R7 and must be visible. Baseline: 98.92%.
The transformation policy imputes instead of dropping (0 victims discarded). Any delta means victims were lost or duplicated by aggregation or the integration join.
Each raw report must be represented exactly once after rollup to the municipal grain.
